ADMIN_GUIDE.title: Admin visual guide
ADMIN_GUIDE.audience: For client administrators and operations teams

pages.title: Sign in with your own staff account

steps.title: Enter your credentials
steps.body: Use your individual username and password, then select Continue.

steps.title: Complete the security step
steps.body: Follow enrollment if this is your first login. Enter the current authenticator code yourself.

steps.title: Check your workspace
steps.body: Confirm the intended account and INFRA UAT environment before working.

pages.note: No personal wallet connection is needed. Never share passwords, setup keys or authenticator codes.

pages.title: Start with the platform overview

steps.title: Check platform health
steps.body: Read service and indexer status before interpreting the numbers.

steps.title: Read the right balance
steps.body: Primary proceeds, revenue funding and reward claims are different records.

steps.title: Choose your next area
steps.body: Use the left navigation for Projects, Treasury & revenue and Transactions. Detailed histories are available below the overview.

pages.note: These are dated UAT examples. Unavailable or delayed data is not the same as a zero balance.

pages.title: Find or create a project

steps.title: Find the named project
steps.body: Search the list and check its draft/published state before opening it.

steps.title: Open the project
steps.body: Use its name to inspect content, economics, media and lifecycle.

steps.title: Start a new draft
steps.body: Choose Create project only when you have approved content and economics.

pages.note: A draft is an internal record. Publication and opening the sale are later, separate actions.

pages.title: Draft step 1: describe the project

steps.title: Give it a clear name
steps.body: Use the name investors should recognize. Label test projects clearly.

steps.title: Explain the project
steps.body: Enter the description and optional location with approved public wording.

steps.title: Continue to economics
steps.body: Continue moves to the next step; it does not publish a project.

pages.note: Public content must not contain passwords, confidential records or private support material.

pages.title: Draft step 2: check the price

steps.title: Enter total value
steps.body: Enter the approved project value in USDT.

steps.title: Enter whole fractions
steps.body: Set the maximum fraction count. Check that the value divides exactly at supported precision.

steps.title: Check the calculated price
steps.body: The displayed per-share price must match the agreed economics before continuing.

pages.note: Unsaved demonstration: 10 USDT / 10,000 fractions = 0.001 USDT each. Do not copy sample values into a real project.

pages.title: Draft step 3: owner and treasury

steps.title: Check the owner
steps.body: The configured shared admin wallet is the project owner. Staff cannot replace it with MetaMask.

steps.title: Choose an approved treasury
steps.body: Select the approved destination for primary-sale withdrawals.

steps.title: Continue after checking
steps.body: Check both destinations before continuing. The owner manages the contract; the treasury receives primary proceeds.

pages.note: Selecting a treasury is a business decision. A destination must be approved before it appears in this list.

pages.title: Draft step 4: review, then save

steps.title: Review every field
steps.body: Check the name, description, owner, treasury, total value, supply and price.

steps.title: Acknowledge the review
steps.body: Select the acknowledgment only after checking the information.

steps.title: Save the project draft
steps.body: Reopen the saved draft and add public media. Saving does not create a blockchain project.

pages.note: This screenshot is an unsaved demonstration. No draft was created for the guide.

pages.title: Add the project image and documents

steps.title: Select the public file
steps.body: Choose an approved project image or public document, within the displayed 10 MiB limit.

steps.title: Review public permanence
steps.body: Read the acknowledgment before upload. Public project media is different from private support files.

steps.title: Prepare the metadata revision
steps.body: Wait for upload/pinning, then check the current revision and image before publication.

pages.note: On a published project, applying a new metadata revision is a separate authorized transaction. Frozen metadata cannot be casually replaced.

pages.title: Read the exact publication review

steps.title: Check the frozen values
steps.body: Read the owner, treasury, maximum fractions, total value and metadata. Approval applies to this exact request.

steps.title: Check network and expiry
steps.body: Use the intended INFRA chain and a current review. Scroll through all transaction details.

steps.title: Approve personally
steps.body: When the values match, acknowledge them and use a fresh code with Approve with authenticator. Track the result in Transactions.

pages.note: Archived 21 Oct example, already expired. Never reuse these values as a live approval. A second approver may be required by policy.

pages.title: Open or close a primary sale

steps.title: Check the project state
steps.body: Open Lifecycle on the intended published project.

steps.title: Open the sale separately
steps.body: Use Open sale, review the exact contract/fee and approve with a fresh authenticator code.

steps.title: Verify before announcing
steps.body: Wait for confirmed/indexed status, then check that the investor project can be bought.

pages.note: Closing a sale stops new primary purchases after confirmation. It does not refund investors or erase their shares.

pages.title: Understand treasury and revenue

steps.title: Primary proceeds
steps.body: Purchase funds held for the approved treasury are separate from investor rewards.

steps.title: Revenue and claims
steps.body: Review actual revenue deposits and the amounts investors have claimed.

steps.title: Prepare approved funding
steps.body: Choose Fund project revenue for a new revenue deposit. Use the breakdown and history tabs below for existing records.

pages.note: A yield setting does not create rewards. Only confirmed revenue funding makes assets available for claims.

pages.title: Prepare a revenue deposit

steps.title: Choose project, asset and amount
steps.body: Select the published project and intended deposit. The contract must have issued holders.

steps.title: Use the automatic reference
steps.body: The form creates the unique funding reference. Optionally select a PDF, CSV or XLSX report for a local fingerprint.

steps.title: Review and approve funding
steps.body: Acknowledge the purpose, then review exact values. USDT allowance, if needed, is a separate approval before funding.

pages.note: The report file stays on your device; only its fingerprint is referenced. Keep the original. Do not repeat an uncertain deposit.

pages.title: Follow a transaction to completion

steps.title: Find the existing request
steps.body: Use the project, action and time to identify the request you already submitted.

steps.title: Read its state
steps.body: Prepared is not broadcast; confirmed is not yet the same as indexed in the app.

steps.title: Investigate uncertainty
steps.body: Open details and preserve the request/hash. Refresh the existing attempt before creating another one.

pages.note: If a result is uncertain, do not repeat the transaction. An on-chain failure can still use a network fee.

pages.title: Create separate staff access

steps.title: Enter the staff identity
steps.body: Use the intended person's name and individual username.

steps.title: Confirm the intended scope
steps.body: Review the acknowledgment. Creating the account alone does not assign every permission.

steps.title: Complete invitation and roles
steps.body: The account starts suspended. Use the supported setup invitation and authorized role assignment; the recipient sets password and MFA.

pages.note: Use the least access needed. Reserved super-admin grants and exceptional recovery require the protected owner/operator procedure.

pages.title: Connect your reID account

steps.title: Select Continue with reID
steps.body: Open the investor app and choose this button.

steps.title: Complete reID sign-in
steps.body: Review profile/wallet access and complete your own security steps.

steps.title: Check your identity on return
steps.body: Confirm your own profile and wallet before depositing or investing.

pages.note: Connecting signs you into the app. Every purchase, transfer or claim needs its own later approval.

pages.title: Understand your Home dashboard

steps.title: Use the navigation
steps.body: Explore finds projects; My earnings shows rewards; Wallet and Activity track assets and records.

steps.title: Read the summary cards
steps.body: Portfolio value, claimable rewards and wallet balance describe different things.

steps.title: Check the portfolio below
steps.body: Scroll to Your holdings for the projects and quantities you actually own.

pages.note: Screens show one UAT account on 23 Oct 2026. Values change; they are not example amounts you should send.

pages.title: Deposit into your connected wallet

steps.title: Choose reAED or USDT
steps.body: Use the supported asset on INFRA. Bank/card options marked Coming soon are unavailable.

steps.title: Copy your own address
steps.body: Use the live address or QR from your account. Check network, address and amount in the sending wallet.

steps.title: Refresh after confirmation
steps.body: The app records confirmed deposits after indexing. Entering an amount here does not send money.

pages.note: Do not send to the address or scan the QR in this guide. Open your own live Deposit screen. Keep reAED for fees, even when paying with USDT.

pages.title: See your five latest deposits

steps.title: Read asset and confirmation
steps.body: Each card shows the asset, amount and date of a received payment.

steps.title: Open the transaction link
steps.body: Use the explorer link to inspect the underlying confirmed movement.

steps.title: Choose See more
steps.body: This opens Activity with the Deposits filter selected for the full paginated history.

pages.note: A claim or proceeds withdrawal can also appear as an incoming deposit. Do not count the same transaction twice.

pages.title: Explore the published projects

steps.title: Read the project cards
steps.body: Check the project name, image and published information.

steps.title: Open a project
steps.body: Read its details, available supply, price and documents before buying.

steps.title: Compare actual revenue
steps.body: Treat funded revenue records separately from indicative yield or expectations.

pages.note: These are UAT sample valuations. Future revenue and a resale buyer are not guaranteed.

pages.title: Read the project before buying

steps.title: Confirm the project
steps.body: Check the name, purpose and published description before selecting shares.

steps.title: Read the project information
steps.body: Scroll through the project overview, supply, price and actual revenue details.

steps.title: Check published documents
steps.body: Review any supporting documents before moving to Choose your shares.

pages.note: A dash or unavailable message is not always zero. Do not treat a projected yield as already funded rewards.

pages.title: Choose shares and check the total

steps.title: Choose a whole quantity
steps.body: Use the quantity control or presets. Confirm the selected share of the project.

steps.title: Select the payment asset
steps.body: reAED pays natively; USDT may require a separate limited allowance. Both need reAED for fees.

steps.title: Review the current total
steps.body: Wait for the matching quote, check the total, then select Review purchase.

pages.note: The total shown is the purchase price. Network fees are extra and are checked in the transaction review.

pages.title: Prepare, then approve in reID

steps.title: Check the initial action
steps.body: Confirm the project, asset and whole-fraction quantity.

steps.title: Prepare the transaction
steps.body: The app checks price, balance and fee and creates the exact review.

steps.title: Approve only the matching review
steps.body: Select Request reID approval when available, review in reID yourself, then follow the existing request in Activity.

pages.note: This screenshot is the first review stage. No purchase happens merely by opening it. If a submitted result is uncertain, inspect it before retrying.

pages.title: Find and use your holdings

steps.title: Find the right project
steps.body: Use project names/images and the search/sort controls.

steps.title: Read quantity and claimable value
steps.body: Shares are token quantity; To claim is funded rewards, not cash already in your wallet.

steps.title: Use the next-action buttons
steps.body: My earnings opens rewards; Buy more returns to the project purchase flow.

pages.note: ERC-1155 example: 100 fractions can appear as one NFT card with Qty 100. Missing external artwork does not mean the tokens are missing.

pages.title: Transfer fractions to another wallet

steps.title: Open Transfer or sell your shares
steps.body: Find this section near the bottom of the project page.

steps.title: Enter recipient and quantity
steps.body: Check the complete wallet address and choose a whole number within your holdings.

steps.title: Review and approve the transfer
steps.body: Use Review transfer, then approve the matching INFRA action in reID. Wait for confirmed records.

pages.note: Sending 20 of 100 leaves 80 for you and gives the recipient quantity 20 of the same project token ID 1. Past earned rewards stay with their earner.
pages.route: Project > Transfer or sell your shares

pages.title: Offer shares for resale

steps.title: Enter listing terms
steps.body: Choose whole quantity, payment asset, price per share and expiry.

steps.title: Approve the operator if needed
steps.body: Review marketplace permission for this project. It is separate from the listing itself.

steps.title: Review the listing
steps.body: Approve the listing in reID. Monitor fills/expiry; claim seller proceeds separately when available.

pages.note: A listing does not guarantee a buyer. Cancelling cannot undo a completed fill. Operator approval covers the project token, not only a fixed quantity.
pages.route: Project > Transfer or sell your shares

pages.title: Check and claim funded rewards

steps.title: Choose the intended project
steps.body: Select the project at the top of My earnings, then find its claim card. Confirm the project name before continuing.

steps.title: Check what is claimable
steps.body: Only funded rewards can be claimed. A zero balance can leave the claim action disabled.

steps.title: Review the claim and fee
steps.body: Use the available claim action, approve in reID and check the wallet after confirmation.

pages.note: A claim does not sell shares. Already-earned rewards remain claimable after you transfer or sell your entire holding.

pages.title: Send wallet funds or sell shares

steps.title: Choose the source
steps.body: Select reAED, USDT or Sell shares. Selling shares follows the marketplace flow.

steps.title: Enter amount and destination
steps.body: For a wallet transfer, continue through amount and the full INFRA recipient address.

steps.title: Review before approving
steps.body: Check asset, recipient, amount and fee. Approve in reID only when all values match.

pages.note: Sending wallet funds is different from claiming rewards or selling fractions. The recipient gets the reviewed transfer amount; gas is separate.

pages.title: Track activity and get help

steps.title: Filter the history
steps.body: Use All, Payouts, Buys, Deposits or Withdrawals.

steps.title: Use page numbers and totals
steps.body: Browse the server-filtered records; Showing X-Y of Z tells you where you are.

steps.title: Inspect the request or ask for help
steps.body: Use transaction links, the Transaction approvals section and Get help for a specific record.

pages.note: For support, describe the action/time/error and include its public hash. Private screenshots: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 3 MiB. Never include keys or codes.

pages.title: Manage notifications and email

steps.title: Read the update
steps.body: Open relevant activity to inspect the underlying transaction or support event.

steps.title: Mark updates as read
steps.body: Use Mark all as read to clear unread notifications. This does not approve transactions.

steps.title: Save your preferences
steps.body: Choose in-app and email categories, then Save preferences. Email comes from your authenticated reID profile.

pages.note: No second email confirmation is required. Your opt-outs are respected. Use Support for a private ticket and sign out when finished.
